summary: Recent updates to the negotiation engine in Firefox, specifically the JSEP (JavaScript Session Establishment Protocol), improve video and audio communication by optimizing how it handles RTP (Real-time Transport Protocol) header extensions. By transitioning these extensions to a more efficient format, Firefox enhances its performance in managing media streams. Additionally, the changes include filtering remote entries that overlap with the local SSRCs (Synchronization Source Identifiers), which helps prevent potential conflicts during media playback. These updates are significant because they contribute to more reliable and smoother multimedia experiences in applications that rely on WebRTC, the underlying technology for video calls and real-time communication.
